	if v12.PVP then
		local v15 = {
			workspace.Items,
			workspace.Particles,
			workspace.Map.Blockers,
			workspace.Map.Water,
			v_u_2.Character
		}
		local v16 = RaycastParams.new()
		v16.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		v16.FilterDescendantsInstances = v15
		v12.ProjectileParams = v16
	end
	return v12
end

function v_u_1.Fire(p_u_18, p19, p20) -- name: Fire
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4
	if p_u_18.Reloading then
		return
	else
		local v21 = p_u_18.RealModel:GetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime")
		if v21 and time() < v21 then
			return
		elseif p_u_18.RealModel:GetAttribute("ServerReloading") then
			return
		else
			local v22 = v_u_2.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if v22 then
				if v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
					if p_u_18.AmmoType == "Energy" then
						if not v_u_3.EnergyResourceClient.CanUseEnergy(p_u_18.EnergyCost) then
							v_u_3.Sound.Play("Alien_GunFailed")
							v_u_3.EnergyResourceClient.EnergyTooLowIndicator(v_u_3.EnergyResourceClient.GetCurrentEnergy(), p_u_18.EnergyCost)
							return
						end
					elseif p_u_18.Ammo <= 0 then
						p_u_18:Reload()
						return
					end
					if time() >= p_u_18.LastFired + p_u_18.FireRate then
						p_u_18.LastFired = time()
						local v23 = p_u_18.Model.PrimaryPart.FireSound
						if p_u_18.RealModel.Name == "Raygun" then
							v23.PlaybackSpeed = 1 - v_u_5:NextNumber() * 0.08 / 2
						end
						v23:Play()
						local v24 = v_u_2:GetAttribute("Explosive" .. (p_u_18.RealModel:GetAttribute("AmmoType") or "RifleAmmo"))
						local v25 = v24 and v24 > 0 and true or false
						local v_u_26 = p_u_18.RealModel:GetAttribute("ExplosiveBulletChance") and p_u_18.RealModel:GetAttribute("ExplosiveBulletChance") >= v_u_5:NextInteger(1, 100) and true or v25
						if v_u_26 then
							v_u_3.Sound.Play("ExplosiveRoundShot", {
								["Volume"] = 0.12,
								["Replicate"] = true,
								["ReplicationProperties"] = nil,
								["ReplicationProperties"] = {
									["Instance"] = nil,
									["Volume"] = 0.12,
									["Instance"] = v_u_2.Character.Head
								}
							})
						end
						v_u_3.Events.PlayAnimation:Fire("RifleFire")
						v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.PlayAnimation("RifleFire")
						task.spawn(function()
							-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_18, (ref) v_u_3
							if p_u_18.Model:FindFirstChild("MuzzlePart") then
								if v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.IsVisible() then
									local v27 = v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.GetTool()
									if v27 then
										if v27.MuzzlePart:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment") then
											v_u_3.Utility.RunParticles(v27.MuzzlePart:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment"))
										else
											local v28 = v27.MuzzlePart.ParticleOuter
											v28:Emit(v28:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 20)
											local v29 = v27.MuzzlePart.ParticleInner
											v29:Emit(v29:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 10)
										end
									end
								else
									if p_u_18.Model.MuzzlePart:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment") then
										v_u_3.Utility.RunParticles(p_u_18.Model.MuzzlePart:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment"))
										return
									end
									local v30 = p_u_18.Model.MuzzlePart.ParticleOuter
									v30:Emit(v30:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 20)
									local v31 = p_u_18.Model.MuzzlePart.ParticleInner
									v31:Emit(v31:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 10)
								end
							end
						end)
						local v32 = p_u_18.Model.Barrel.Position
						if v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.IsVisible() then
							local v33 = v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.GetTool()
							if v33 then
								v32 = v33.Barrel.Position
							end
						end
						local v34 = p19 or v_u_4.UnitRay
						local v35
						if v_u_3.PVPZoneClient.IsInPVPZone(v_u_2) then
							print("in pvp zone, use custom params")
							local v36 = {
								workspace.Items,
								workspace.Particles,
								workspace.Map.Blockers,
								workspace.Map.Water,
								v_u_2.Character
							}
							v35 = RaycastParams.new()
							v35.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
							v35.FilterDescendantsInstances = v36
						else
							v35 = nil
						end
						Ray.new(v34.Origin, v34.Direction * 500)
						local v37 = workspace:Raycast(v34.Origin, v34.Direction * 500, v35 or v_u_3.CollisionUtility.ProjectileParams)
						local v38
						if v37 then
							v38 = v37.Position
						else
							v38 = v34.Origin + v34.Direction * 500
						end
						local v39 = (v38 - v32).Unit
						if p20 ~= "MobileButton" then
							v39 = v_u_3.AimAssistClient.GetAimAssistDir(v32, v39, p_u_18.RealModel.Name)
						end
						local v40 = p_u_18.BulletStray
						if v40 then
							local v41 = p_u_18.BulletStray
							v40 = math.rad(v41)
						end
						local v42 = CFrame.lookAlong(Vector3.new(), v39)
						local v43 = v39 * p_u_18.ProjectileSpeed
						if p_u_18.BulletStray then
							v43 = (v42 * CFrame.Angles(v40 * (v_u_5:NextNumber() - 0.5), v40 * (v_u_5:NextNumber() - 0.5), 0)).LookVector * p_u_18.ProjectileSpeed
						end
						local v_u_44 = p_u_18.RealModel:GetAttribute("AmmoType") or "RifleAmmo"
						local v45 = {}
						v_u_2:GetAttribute("Explosive" .. v_u_44)
						if v_u_26 then
							v45.Explosive = true
						end
						local v46 = v22.Position
						local v_u_47 = v_u_3.ProjectileClass.new(p_u_18, v32, v43, nil, v46, v45, nil, v35)
						task.spawn(function()
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_18, (copy) v_u_47, (ref) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_44
							local v48 = v_u_3.Events.RegisterProjectile:InvokeServer(p_u_18.RealModel, v_u_47.ProjectileId, v_u_26)
							if not (v48 and v48.Success) and v_u_44 ~= "Energy" then
								local v49 = p_u_18
								v49.Ammo = v49.Ammo + 1
								p_u_18:UpdateAmmo()
							end
						end)
						if v_u_44 == "Energy" then
							local v50 = p_u_18.EnergyCost
							v_u_3.EnergyResourceClient.ConsumeEnergy(v50)
						else
							p_u_18.Ammo = p_u_18.Ammo - 1
							p_u_18:UpdateAmmo()
						end
						v_u_47:Fire()
						if p_u_18.ShotCount and p_u_18.ShotCount > 1 then
							for _ = 1, p_u_18.ShotCount - 1 do
								if p_u_18.BulletStray then
									v43 = (v42 * CFrame.Angles(v40 * (v_u_5:NextNumber() - 0.5), v40 * (v_u_5:NextNumber() - 0.5), 0)).LookVector * (p_u_18.ProjectileSpeed + v_u_5:NextInteger(-15, 15))
								end
								v_u_3.ProjectileClass.new(p_u_18, v32, v43, v_u_47.ProjectileId, v46, v45, nil, v35):Fire()
							end
						end
					end
				else
					return
				end
			else
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_1.UpdateParticles(p53) -- name: UpdateParticles
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_51, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_52
	local v54 = p53.Model:FindFirstChild("CursedItemEffects")
	if v54 then
		local v55 = p53.RealModel:GetAttribute("CorruptionStability") or 100
		for _, v56 in pairs(v54:GetChildren()) do
			if not v56:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				continue
			end
			local v57 = v56.Name
			if string.sub(v57, 1, 6) == "State1" then
				if v55 > 25 and v55 <= 50 then
					v56.Enabled = true
					if v_u_51[p53.Model] then
						continue
					end
					v_u_51[p53.Model] = true
					v_u_3.Sound.Play("EnergyPulseLight")
				else
					v56.Enabled = false
				end
			else
				local v58 = v56.Name
				if string.sub(v58, 1, 6) ~= "State2" then
					continue
				end
				if v55 <= 25 then
					v56.Enabled = true
					if v_u_52[p53.Model] then
						continue
					end
					v_u_52[p53.Model] = true
					v_u_3.Sound.Play("EnergyPulseMedium")
				else
					v56.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.UpdateAmmo(p59) -- name: UpdateAmmo
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_3
	local v60 = p59.RealModel:GetAttribute("AmmoType") or "RifleAmmo"
	if v60 == "Energy" then
		return
	else
		local v61 = v_u_2:GetAttribute(v60) or 0
		if v60 == "Infinite" then
			v61 = "\226\136\158"
		elseif v60 == "AutoReload" then
			v61 = p59.RealModel:GetAttribute("MagazineSize")
		end
		local v62 = v_u_2:GetAttribute("Explosive" .. v60)
		if v62 and v62 > 0 then
			v_u_6.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.Visible = true
			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.Text = "x" .. v62
		elseif p59.RealModel:GetAttribute("CorruptionStability") then
			v_u_6.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(115, 0, 255)
			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(115, 0, 255)

			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.Visible = true
			local v63 = p59.RealModel:GetAttribute("CorruptionStability") or 100
			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.Text = 100 - v63 .. "%"
			p59:UpdateParticles()
		else
			v_u_6.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			v_u_6.SpecialAmmo.Visible = false
			v_u_6.SpecialAmmoAmount.Visible = false
		end
		local v64 = p59.Ammo == 0 and 1 or 0
		if p59.Model then
			for _, v65 in pairs(p59.Model:GetDescendants()) do
				if not v65:IsA("BasePart") or v65.Name ~= "AmmoPart" then
					continue
				end
				v65.Transparency = v64
			end
		end
		local v66 = v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.GetTool()
		if v66 then
			for _, v67 in pairs(v66:GetDescendants()) do
				if not v67:IsA("BasePart") or v67.Name ~= "AmmoPart" then
					continue
				end
				v67.Transparency = v64
			end
		end
		local v68 = p59.RealModel:GetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime")
		if v68 and time() < v68 then
			v_u_6.Text = "Reloading..."
		else
			v_u_6.Text = p59.Ammo .. " / " .. v61
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.Reload(p69) -- name: Reload
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_8
	if p69.Reloading then
		return
	elseif p69.RealModel:GetAttribute("ServerReloading") then
		return
	else
		local v70 = p69.RealModel:GetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime")
		if v70 and time() < v70 then
			return
		elseif p69.Ammo == p69.MagazineSize then
			return
		else
			local v71 = p69.RealModel:GetAttribute("AmmoType") or "RifleAmmo"
			if v71 == "Energy" then
				return
			elseif v71 == "Infinite" or (v_u_2:GetAttribute(v71) or 0) ~= 0 then
				p69.Reloading = true
				local v72 = time()
				p69.RealModel:SetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime", time() + p69.ReloadTime)
				p69:UpdateAmmo()
				local v73 = v_u_3.Events.RequestReloadFirearm:InvokeServer(p69.RealModel)
				if v73 and (v73.Success and p69.Equipped) then
					if v71 == "Infinite" and p69.RealModel.Name == "Blowpipe" then
						v_u_3.Sound.Play("BlowpipeReload")
					elseif v71 == "Infinite" and p69.RealModel:GetAttribute("UniqueToolType") == "Crossbow" then
						v_u_3.Sound.Play(v_u_8[p69.RealModel.Name] or "BowReload")
					else
						v_u_3.Sound.Play("Reload")
					end
					local v74 = time() - v72
					if v74 < p69.ReloadTime then
						task.wait(p69.ReloadTime - v74)
					end
					p69.RealModel:SetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime", nil)
					if p69.Equipped then
						p69.Ammo = v73.Ammo
						p69:UpdateAmmo()
					end
				elseif v73 == nil then
					p69.RealModel:SetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime", nil)
					if p69.Equipped then
						p69:UpdateAmmo()
					end
				end
				p69.Reloading = false
			else
				v_u_3.Sound.Play("NoAmmo")
			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.Activate(p_u_75, p_u_76, p_u_77) -- name: Activate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v78 = v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.GetCurrentPlatform()
	if not p_u_75.Automatic or (v78 ~= "Touch" or p_u_77 == "MobileButton") then
		local v_u_79 = p_u_75.MouseDownTick + 1
		p_u_75.MouseDownTick = v_u_79
		if p_u_75.Automatic then
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_76, (copy) p_u_77, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_75, (copy) v_u_79
				if p_u_76 == nil and p_u_77 == "MobileButton" then
					local v80 = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
					local v81 = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
					v_u_3.Interface.MobileCursor.Visible = true
					p_u_76 = workspace.CurrentCamera:ScreenPointToRay(v80.X / 2, v80.Y / 2 - v81.Y)
				end
				p_u_75:Fire(p_u_76, p_u_77)
				p_u_76 = nil
				task.wait(p_u_75.FireRate)
				if p_u_75.MouseDownTick == v_u_79 and not (p_u_75.Reloading or p_u_75.RealModel:GetAttribute("ServerReloading")) then
					if p_u_75.Ammo > 0 then
						continue
					end
					p_u_75.AutoFire = false
					v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.RefreshButtonStyles()
				end
			end)
		else
			p_u_75:Fire(p_u_76)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_1.ToggleAutoFire(p98) -- name: ToggleAutoFire

function v_u_1.TrackAutoFire(p_u_99) -- name: TrackAutoFire
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	p_u_99.CurrentlyHovering = false
	v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.ShowButton("Auto Fire")
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_99, (ref) v_u_3
		while true do
			if p_u_99.Ammo <= 0 then
				p_u_99.AutoFire = false
				v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.RefreshButtonStyles()
			end
			if p_u_99:IsHoveringEnemy() and (not p_u_99.CurrentlyHovering and p_u_99.AutoFire) then
				print("TARGET")
				p_u_99.CurrentlyHovering = true
				p_u_99:Activate(nil, "MobileButton")
			elseif p_u_99.CurrentlyHovering then
				p_u_99.CurrentlyHovering = false
				p_u_99:Deactivate()
			end
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_1.OnEquip(p_u_100) -- name: OnEquip

	p_u_100.Equipped = true
	local v101 = v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.GetCurrentPlatform()
	v_u_7:BindActionAtPriority("ReloadFirearm", function(_, p102, _)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_100
		if not v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if p102 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			p_u_100:Reload()
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
	end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, Enum.KeyCode.R, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY)
	p_u_100.ReloadListener = v_u_3.Events.RequestReloadWeapon:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
		p_u_100:Reload()
	end)
	v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.ShowButton("Shoot")
	v_u_2:GetMouse().Icon = "rbxassetid://107221172731109"
	local v103 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttribute("AmmoType") or "RifleAmmo"
	p_u_100.AmmoType = v103
	if v103 == "Energy" then
		v_u_3.EnergyResourceClient.ShowEnergyBar(p_u_100.RealModel.Name)
	else
		if v103 ~= "AutoReload" then
			v_u_3.GuiButtonHandler.ShowButton("Reload")
		end
		local _ = v_u_2:GetAttribute(v103) or 0
		local _ = v103 == "Infinite"
		p_u_100:UpdateAmmo()
		v_u_6.Visible = true
		p_u_100.AmmoChangedEvent = v_u_2:GetAttributeChangedSignal(v103):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100:UpdateAmmo()
		end)
		p_u_100.AmmoChangedEvent2 = v_u_2:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Explosive" .. v103):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100:UpdateAmmo()
		end)
		p_u_100.AmmoChangedEvent3 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CorruptionStability"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100:UpdateAmmo()
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			local v104 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttribute("ReloadFinishTime")
			if v104 and time() < v104 then
				local v105 = v104 - time() + 0.01
				task.wait(v105)
				p_u_100:UpdateAmmo()
			end
		end)
	end
	if v_u_2:GetAttribute("Class") == "Gunslinger" and p_u_100.RealModel.Name == "Trusty Revolver" then
		p_u_100.AutoUpdateEvents = {}
		local v106 = p_u_100.AutoUpdateEvents
		local v107 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ProjectileSpeed")
		table.insert(v106, v107:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100.ProjectileSpeed = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttribute("ProjectileSpeed")
		end))
		local v108 = p_u_100.AutoUpdateEvents
		local v109 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ReloadTime")
		table.insert(v108, v109:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100.ReloadTime = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttribute("ReloadTime")
		end))
		local v110 = p_u_100.AutoUpdateEvents
		local v111 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ProjectileDamage")
		table.insert(v110, v111:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100.ProjectileDamage = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttribute("ProjectileDamage")
		end))
		local v112 = p_u_100.AutoUpdateEvents
		local v113 = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttributeChangedSignal("FireRate")
		table.insert(v112, v113:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_100
			p_u_100.FireRate = p_u_100.RealModel:GetAttribute("FireRate")

function EmitEffects(p38, p39) -- name: EmitEffects
	if p38 and p38:IsA("Instance") then
		local v40 = next
		local v41, v42 = p38:GetDescendants()
		local v43 = 0
		for _, v_u_44 in v40, v41, v42 do
			if not v_u_44:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				continue
			end
			if v_u_44:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") then
				task.delay(v_u_44:GetAttribute("EmitDelay"), function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
					v_u_44:Emit(v_u_44:GetAttribute("EmitCount"))
				end)
			else
				v_u_44:Emit(v_u_44:GetAttribute("EmitCount"))
			end
			if v43 >= v_u_44.Lifetime.Max or not p39 then
				continue
			end
			v43 = v_u_44.Lifetime.Max
		end
		if p39 then
			task.delay(v43, p38.Destroy, p38)
		end
	end
end
function MusicNote(p_u_45, p_u_46) -- name: MusicNote
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_45, (ref) v_u_2, (copy) p_u_46, (ref) v_u_4
		local v47 = p_u_45:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, -1.5)
		local v48 = Random.new()
		local v49 = v_u_2.Assets.Particles.PetTaming.MusicNotes
		local v50 = v49.Notes:GetChildren()[math.random(1, #v49.Notes:GetChildren())]
		local v51 = v50:GetChildren()[math.random(1, #v50:GetChildren())]:Clone()
		v51:PivotTo(v47)
		v51.Parent = workspace.Particles
		local v52 = v49.Spawn:Clone()
		v52:PivotTo(v51:GetPivot())
		v52.Parent = workspace.Particles
		EmitEffects(v52, true)
		local v53 = v47.Position
		local v54 = (v47 * CFrame.new(v48:NextNumber(-30, 30), 0, v48:NextNumber(-30, 30))).Position
		for v55 = 0, 1, 0.025 do
			v53:Lerp(v54, v55)
			v54:Lerp(p_u_46:GetPivot().Position, v55)
			v51:PivotTo(CFrame.new(v53:Lerp(v54, v55):Lerp(p_u_46:GetPivot().Position, v55)))
			v_u_4.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
		local v56 = v49.Contact:Clone()
		v56:PivotTo(v51:GetPivot())
		v56.Parent = workspace.Particles
		EmitEffects(v56, true)
		v51:Destroy()
	end)
end

			end

		elseif p65 == "Question" then
			if not (p66 and p66.PrimaryPart) then
				return
			end
			local v72 = v_u_2.Assets.Particles.PetTaming.TamedQuestionMark:GetChildren()

		end

		return
	end

function AdjustFaceIcons(p_u_116, p_u_117) -- name: AdjustFaceIcons
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_114, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_115, (copy) v_u_35
	if p_u_117.Parent then
		local v118 = p_u_116:GetAttribute("CurrentTamingState") or "Angry"
		local v119 = p_u_116:GetAttribute("TamingProgress_" .. v_u_7.UserId) or 0
		local v120 = v_u_114[p_u_116] or 0
		v_u_114[p_u_116] = v119
		local v121 = v118 == "Angry" and v119 > 0 and "Neutral" or v118
		local v122 = v_u_10[v121] or v_u_10.Neutral
		if v121 == "Hungry" then
			p_u_117.Frame.Visible = false
			ShowHungerBubbles(p_u_116)
		else
			if not v_u_115[p_u_116] then
				p_u_117.Frame.Visible = true
			end
			if v_u_35[p_u_116] then
				v_u_35[p_u_116].Enabled = false
			end
		end
		if v121 == "Tamed" and p_u_116:GetAttribute("TamedAnimation") == nil then
			v_u_115[p_u_116] = true

				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_115, (copy) p_u_116

			end)
			p_u_116:SetAttribute("TamedAnimation", true)
			p_u_117.Frame.Visible = false
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_117, (copy) p_u_116
				wait(0.21)
				task.spawn(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_117
					wait(0.5)
					p_u_117.Frame.Visible = false
				end)
				local v123 = p_u_117:Clone()
				p_u_117.Frame.Visible = false
				v123.Enabled = false
				v123.Frame.Visible = true
				v123.Parent = p_u_117.Parent
				DoHeartAnimation(v123, p_u_117, p_u_116:GetAttribute("RequiredTamingSteps"))
				AdjustHeartHealth(p_u_116, p_u_117)
			end)
		end
		local v124 = p_u_117.Frame
		local v125 = p_u_116:GetAttribute("RequiredTamingSteps") or 3
		for v126 = 1, v125 do
			local v127 = v124:FindFirstChild("Health" .. v126)
			if not v127 then
				continue
			end
			v127.Image = v122.Icon
			v127.ImageColor3 = v122.Color3
			if (v121 == "Neutral" or v121 == "Angry") and v126 <= v119 then
				v127.Image = v_u_10.Happy.Icon
				v127.ImageColor3 = v_u_10.Happy.Color3
			end
			if v125 <= 1 or (v126 ~= 1 or (v119 ~= 0 or (v_u_7:GetAttribute("Class") ~= "Zookeeper" or (v_u_7:GetAttribute("ClassLevel") or 1) < 3))) then
				continue
			end
			v127.Image = v_u_10.Neutral.Icon
			v127.ImageColor3 = v_u_10.Neutral.Color3

		end
	end
end
function CreatePiles(p85, p86, p87) -- name: CreatePiles
	local v88 = p85:WaitForChild("PileMetal1"):GetAttribute("Piles")
	local v89 = p85:WaitForChild("PileWood1"):GetAttribute("Piles")
	if p86 < v88 then
		for v90 = v88, p86 + 1, -1 do
			if v90 == 1 then
				p85:FindFirstChild("PileMetal1").Transparency = 1
			else
				if not p85:FindFirstChild("PileMetal" .. v90) then
					continue
				end
				p85:FindFirstChild("PileMetal" .. v90):Destroy()
			end
		end
	elseif v88 < p86 then
		for v91 = v88 + 1, p86 do
			if v91 == 1 then
				p85:FindFirstChild("PileMetal1").Transparency = 0
			else
				if v91 == 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v92 = p85.PileMetal1:Clone()
				v92.Parent = p85
				v92.Name = "PileMetal" .. v91
				v92:PivotTo(p85:FindFirstChild("PileMetal1").CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (v91 - 1) * 0.38, 0))
			end
		end
	end
	if p87 < v89 then
		for v93 = v89, p87 + 1, -1 do
			if v93 == 1 then
				p85:FindFirstChild("PileWood1").Transparency = 1
			else
				if not p85:FindFirstChild("PileWood" .. v93) then
					continue
				end
				p85:FindFirstChild("PileWood" .. v93):Destroy()
			end
		end
	elseif v89 < p87 then
		for v94 = v89 + 1, p87 do
			if v94 == 1 then
				p85:FindFirstChild("PileWood1").Transparency = 0
			else
				if v94 == 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v95 = p85.PileWood1:Clone()
				v95.Parent = p85
				v95.Name = "PileWood" .. v94
				v95:PivotTo(p85:FindFirstChild("PileWood1").CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (v94 - 1) * 0.38, 0))
			end
		end
	end
	p85.PileMetal1:SetAttribute("Piles", p86)
	p85.PileWood1:SetAttribute("Piles", p87)
end
function UpdatePreviewPriceColor() -- name: UpdatePreviewPriceColor
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (ref) v_u_21
	local v96 = v_u_18.Price.ScrapFrame.ScrapAmount.Text
	local v97 = tonumber(v96)
	local v98 = v_u_18.Price.WoodFrame.WoodAmount.Text
	local v99 = tonumber(v98)
	local v100 = v_u_18.Price.GemFrame.GemAmount.Text
	local v101 = tonumber(v100)
	local v102 = v_u_18.Price.GreenGemFrame.GreenGemAmount.Text
	local v103 = tonumber(v102)
	if v97 and (v99 and (v101 and v103)) then
		if v97 <= v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalScrap") then
			v_u_18.Price.ScrapFrame.ScrapAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225)
		else
			v_u_18.Price.ScrapFrame.ScrapAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		end
		if v99 <= v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalWood") then
			v_u_18.Price.WoodFrame.WoodAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225)
		else
			v_u_18.Price.WoodFrame.WoodAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		end
		if v101 <= v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalGems") then
			v_u_18.Price.GemFrame.GemAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225)
		else
			v_u_18.Price.GemFrame.GemAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		end
		if v103 <= v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalGreenGems") then
			v_u_18.Price.GreenGemFrame.GreenGemAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 225)
			return
		end
		v_u_18.Price.GreenGemFrame.GreenGemAmount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	end
end
function UpdateScrap() -- name: UpdateScrap
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_9
	local v104 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalScrap") or 0
	local v105 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalWood") or 0
	local v106 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalGems") or 0
	local v107 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalGreenGems") or 0
	v_u_15.Materials.ScrapAmount.Text = v104
	v_u_15.Materials.WoodAmount.Text = v105
	v_u_15.Materials.GemAmount.Text = v106
	v_u_15.Materials.GreenGemAmount.Text = v107
	v_u_9.Interface.AmmoCrate.Amount.ScrapAmount.Text = v104
	local v108 = v_u_21:WaitForChild("CraftingBench")
	local v109, v110 = CalculatePileAmounts(v104, v105)
	if v108:WaitForChild("ScrapSign") and v108:WaitForChild("WoodSign") then
		v108.ScrapSign.SurfaceGui.TextLabel.Text = v104
		v108.WoodSign.SurfaceGui.TextLabel.Text = "     " .. v105
	end
	UpdatePreviewPriceColor()
	if v106 >= 0 then
		UpdateGemAmount(v108, v106)
	end
	if v107 >= 0 then
		if v107 > 0 then
			v_u_15.Materials.GreenGemAmount.Visible = true
			v_u_15.Materials.GreenGemImage.Visible = true
		end
		UpdateGreenGemAmount(v108, v107)
	end
	CreatePiles(v108, v109, v110)
end
function OnPurchaseBlueprint(p111) -- name: OnPurchaseBlueprint
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	GetButtonFromName(p111)
	local v112 = GetEntryFromName(p111)
	if v112 then
		if table.find(v_u_11.AllowDuplicates, p111) and (not table.find(v_u_11.AllowDuplicates, p111) or v112:GetAttribute("SoldOut")) then
			return
		else
			local v113 = v112:GetAttribute("Limit")
			if v113 then
				v112:SetAttribute("Limit", v113 - 1)
			elseif not table.find(v_u_11.AllowDuplicates, p111) then
				v112:SetAttribute("SoldOut", true)
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function CheckCanBuy(p118) -- name: CheckCanBuy
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_15
	local v119 = GetEntryFromName(p118)
	if v119 then
		local v120 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalWood")
		local v121 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalScrap")
		local v122 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalGems")
		local v123 = v_u_21:GetAttribute("TotalGreenGems")
		local v124 = v119:GetAttribute("WoodPrice")
		local v125 = v119:GetAttribute("ScrapPrice")
		local v126 = v119:GetAttribute("GemPrice")
		local v127 = v119:GetAttribute("GreenGemPrice")
		local v128 = v119:GetAttribute("Limit")
		if table.find(v_u_11.AllowDuplicates, p118) or not v119:GetAttribute("SoldOut") then
			if (v124 and v124 <= v120 or not v124) and ((v126 and v126 <= v122 or not v126) and ((v125 and v125 <= v121 or not v125) and (v127 and v127 <= v123 or not v127))) then
				if not table.find(v_u_11.AllowDuplicates, p118) then
					if v128 then
						if v128 <= 0 then
							v119:SetAttribute("SoldOut", true)
						end
					else
						v119:SetAttribute("SoldOut", true)
					end
				end
				return true
			else
				if v125 and v121 < v125 then
					DoErrorMessage(v_u_15.Materials.ScrapAmount, "not enough scrap")
				elseif v126 and v122 < v126 then
					DoErrorMessage(v_u_15.Materials.GemAmount, "not enough cultist gems")
				elseif v127 and v123 < v127 then
					DoErrorMessage(v_u_15.Materials.GreenGemAmount, "not enough forest gems")
				else
					DoErrorMessage(v_u_15.Materials.WoodAmount, "not enough wood")
				end
				return false
			end
		else
			return false
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function AdjustCaveLight() -- name: AdjustCaveLight
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_2
	if not v_u_20 then
		v_u_20 = true
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_20
			while v_u_3.CaveLightingClient.PlayerInLight and v_u_14 == "CaveCrystal" do
				if v_u_2.Character and (v_u_2.Character.PrimaryPart and (v_u_3.CaveLightingClient.PlayerInLight.PrimaryPart and v_u_3.CaveLightingClient.PlayerInLight:FindFirstChild("TouchZone"))) then
					local v25 = v_u_2.Character.PrimaryPart.Position.X
					local v26 = v_u_2.Character.PrimaryPart.Position.Z
					local v27 = Vector3.new(v25, 0, v26)
					local v28 = v_u_3.CaveLightingClient.PlayerInLight.PrimaryPart.Position.X
					local v29 = v_u_3.CaveLightingClient.PlayerInLight.PrimaryPart.Position.Z
					local v30 = (v27 - Vector3.new(v28, 0, v29)).Magnitude / (v_u_3.CaveLightingClient.PlayerInLight.TouchZone.Size.Y / 2) - 0.5
					local v31 = math.clamp(v30, 0, 0.5)
					SetCaveCrystalLighting(v31)
				end
				updateLighting()
				wait(0.5)
			end
			v_u_20 = false
		end)
	end
end

function updateLighting(p32, p33) -- name: updateLighting
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_1
	local v34, _ = v_u_15()
	local v35 = v_u_12[v34]
	if not v35 then
		print("Warning: No config found for state:", v34)
		v35 = v_u_12.Day
		v34 = "Day"
	end
	local v36 = v34 == "MeteorShower" and 15 or (p32 or 0.4)
	if v34 == "HedgeMaze" and v_u_14 == "HedgeMaze" then
		v36 = 0.2
		if v_u_7.isNightcrawler then
			v35.FogStart = 90
			v35.FogEnd = 250
		elseif v_u_7.flashlight then
			v35.FogStart = 75
			v35.FogEnd = 125
		else
			v35.FogStart = 30
			v35.FogEnd = 96
		end
	end
	local v37 = v35.TimeOfDay or (v_u_7.timeOfDay == "Day" and 14.5 or 0)
	local v38 = game.Lighting.ClockTime
	local v39
	if v38 > 6 then
		v39 = v38 < 20
	else
		v39 = false
	end
	local v40
	if v37 > 6 then
		v40 = v37 < 20
	else
		v40 = false
	end
	if v39 ~= v40 then
		v36 = math.max(v36, 3)
	end
	local v41 = p33 and 0 or v36
	local v42 = v_u_19(v35, v34)
	if v_u_3.CampfireEffectModule.FireEffectEnabled and (v_u_7.biome ~= "Cave" and v42.FogEnd) then
		local v43 = v42.FogEnd
		local v44 = v_u_11
		v42.FogEnd = math.max(v43, v44)
	end
	v_u_1.ChangeColorCorrection(v34, v42, v41)
end

function v_u_1.ChangeColorCorrection(p71, p72, p73) -- name: ChangeColorCorrection
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_3
	v_u_14 = p71
	local v74 = p73 or 0.4
	local v75 = game.Lighting.ColorCorrection
	if v_u_14 == "CaveCrystal" then
		AdjustCaveLight()
	end
	if p72.TintColor then
		v_u_4:Create(v75, TweenInfo.new(v74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["TintColor"] = p72.TintColor
		}):Play()
	end
	if p72.Brightness then
		v_u_4:Create(v75, TweenInfo.new(v74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["Brightness"] = p72.Brightness
		}):Play()
	end
	if p72.Saturation then
		v_u_4:Create(v75, TweenInfo.new(v74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["Saturation"] = p72.Saturation
		}):Play()
	end
	if p72.FogStart then
		v_u_4:Create(game.Lighting, TweenInfo.new(v74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["FogStart"] = p72.FogStart
		}):Play()
	end
	if p72.FogEnd then
		v_u_4:Create(game.Lighting, TweenInfo.new(v74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
			["FogEnd"] = p72.FogEnd
		}):Play()
	end
	if p72.Skybox then
		local v76 = v_u_5.Assets.Skyboxes:FindFirstChild(p72.Skybox):Clone()
		if v_u_8 then
			v_u_8:Destroy()
			v_u_8 = nil
		end
		if v76 then
			v_u_8 = v76
			for _, v77 in pairs(game.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
				if not v77:IsA("Sky") then
					continue
				end
				v77:Destroy()
			end
			v76.Parent = game.Lighting
			local v78 = v_u_9
			table.insert(v78, v76)
		end
	elseif v_u_8 then
		v_u_3.Events.ResetSkybox:FireServer()
	end
	BaseLightingChanges(p72, v74)
end
v_u_3.Events.ResetSkybox:Connect(function(p79)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_5
	if p79 == "All" then
		if v_u_8 then
			for _, v80 in pairs(game.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
				if not v80:IsA("Sky") or v80 == v_u_8 then
					continue
				end
				v80:Destroy()
			end
		else
			for _, v81 in pairs(v_u_9) do
				v81:Destroy()
			end
			if not game.Lighting:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sky") then
				v_u_3.Events.ResetSkybox:FireServer()
			end
		end
	else
		if v_u_8 then
			v_u_8:Destroy()
		end
		v_u_8 = nil
		for _, v82 in pairs(game.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if not v82:IsA("Sky") then
				continue
			end
			v82:Destroy()
		end
		local v83 = v_u_5.Assets.Skyboxes:FindFirstChild(p79):Clone()
		v83.Parent = game.Lighting
		local v84 = v_u_9
		table.insert(v84, v83)
		return
	end
end)

				v_u_15.Parent.SprintWarning.Visible = false
				v_u_15.Parent.FrozenWarning.Visible = true
			else
				v_u_15.Parent.SprintWarning.Visible = true
				v_u_15.Parent.FrozenWarning.Visible = false
			end
		end
		if v_u_8 > 0 then
			v_u_12 = false
			v_u_6.Events.PlayerSprinting:FireServer(true)
		else
			v_u_12 = true
			v_u_6.Events.PlayerSprinting:FireServer(false)
		end
		if v_u_16 then
			v_u_16:Disconnect()
		end
		if v_u_5.Character and v_u_5.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			local v75 = v_u_5.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			local v_u_76 = false
			v75.WalkSpeed = v_u_8
			v_u_16 = v75.Running:Connect(function(p77)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_76, (ref) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_74, (ref) v_u_4
				if v_u_10 then
					if p77 > 0 then
						if not (v_u_76 or v_u_12) then
							v_u_6.Events.PlayerSprinting:FireServer(true)
							v_u_76 = true
							return
						end
					else
						if p_u_74 and p_u_74.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
							v_u_4.StopSprint()
							return
						end

							v_u_6.Events.PlayerSprinting:FireServer(false)
							v_u_76 = false
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function ToggleSprinting(_, p79, p80) -- name: ToggleSprinting
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_4
	if p80 then
		local v81 = p80.UserInputType.Name
		if tostring(v81):sub(1, 7) == "Gamepad" then
			if p79 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
				if not v_u_13 then
					return
				end
				v_u_13 = false
				task.spawn(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13
					wait(0.15)
					v_u_13 = true
				end)
				if v_u_10 then
					v_u_4.StopSprint()
				else
					v_u_4.StartSprint(p80)
				end
			end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		else
			if p79 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
				v_u_4.StartSprint(p80)
			elseif p80.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
				v_u_4.StopSprint()
			end
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
	else
		if p79 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			v_u_4.StartSprint(p80)
		elseif p80.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			v_u_4.StopSprint()
		end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
end

					end

			end
		else
			return
		end
	end

	local v111 = v_u_98
	local v112 = v_u_5.InputChanged

function UpdateMobileButtonScale() -- name: UpdateMobileButtonScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v128 = v_u_2.PlayerGui.MobileButtons.Frame
	local v129 = GetTouchControlFrame()
	local v130 = v129 and v129.AbsoluteSize or v128.Screen.AbsoluteSize
	local v131 = v130.X
	local v132 = v130.Y
	local v133 = math.min(v131, v132) <= 500
	local v134 = v133 and 70 or 120
	v128.Size = UDim2.new(0, v134, 0, v134)
	v128.Position = v133 and UDim2.new(1, -(v134 * 1.5 - 10), 1, -v134 - 20) or UDim2.new(1, -(v134 * 1.5 - 10), 1, -v134 * 1.75)
	ApplyMobileButtonLayout(v128, v134, v133)
end
function ApplyMobileButtonLayout(p135, p136, p137) -- name: ApplyMobileButtonLayout
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v138 = v_u_3.Settings[p137 and "MobileButtonLayoutPhone" or "MobileButtonLayoutTablet"]
	local v139 = p135.Parent.AbsoluteSize
	if v_u_3.GlobalSettings.MobileButtonEditor and (v138 and v139.X ~= 0) then
		local v140 = Vector2.new(v139.X * p135.Position.X.Scale + p135.Position.X.Offset, v139.Y * p135.Position.Y.Scale + p135.Position.Y.Offset)
		local v141 = -v140 / p136
		local v142 = (v139 - v140) / p136
		for v143, v144 in pairs(v138) do
			local v145 = p135:FindFirstChild(v143)
			if not v145 then
				continue
			end
			local v146 = v144.Size / 2
			v145.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			v145.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v144.Size, v144.Size)
			local v147 = UDim2.fromScale
			local v148 = v144.X
			local v149 = v141.X + v146
			local v150 = v142.X - v146
			local v151 = math.clamp(v148, v149, v150)
			local v152 = v144.Y
			local v153 = v141.Y + v146
			local v154 = v142.Y - v146
			v145.Position = v147(v151, (math.clamp(v152, v153, v154)))
		end
	end
end

function sortMobileButtons() -- name: sortMobileButtons
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_102, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_95, (ref) v_u_96, (ref) v_u_97, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_98
	debug.profilebegin("SortButtons")
	debug.profilebegin("SetPriority")
	v_u_102 = {}
	local v165 = v_u_85
	v_u_95 = nil
	v_u_96 = nil
	v_u_97 = nil
	local v166 = -999
	for v167 = 1, #v_u_1.ActiveButtons do
		local v168 = v_u_1.ActiveButtons[v167]
		if v_u_10(v_u_25, v168.Name) or (hideOnMobile(v168.Name) or v166 >= v168.Priority) then
			continue
		end
		v166 = v168.Priority
		v_u_95 = v168
	end
	if v_u_95 then
		local v169 = -999
		for v170 = 1, #v_u_1.ActiveButtons do
			local v171 = v_u_1.ActiveButtons[v170]
			if v_u_10(v_u_25, v171.Name) or (v171.Name == v_u_95.Name or (hideOnMobile(v171.Name) or v169 >= v171.Priority)) then
				continue
			end
			v169 = v171.Priority
			v_u_96 = v171
		end
	end
	for v172 = 1, #v_u_1.ActiveButtons do
		local v173 = v_u_1.ActiveButtons[v172]
		if not v_u_10(v_u_25, v173.Name) or hideOnMobile(v173.Name) then
			continue
		end
		local _ = v173.Priority
		v_u_97 = v173
	end
	if not v_u_97 and (v_u_95 and v_u_96) then
		for v174 = 1, #v_u_1.ActiveButtons do
			local v175 = v_u_1.ActiveButtons[v174]
			if v175.Name == v_u_95.Name or (v175.Name == v_u_96.Name or hideOnMobile(v175.Name)) then
				continue
			end
			local _ = v175.Priority
			v_u_97 = v175
		end
	end
	debug.profileend()
	debug.profilebegin("CreateButtons")
	local v176 = v_u_2.PlayerGui.MobileButtons.Frame
	local v177 = v_u_2.PlayerGui.AvailableInputList.AvailableInputList.AvailableInputList.AvailableInputList
	local v178 = v176.Button1
	local v179 = v176.Button2
	local v180 = v176.Button3
	if v165 == "Touch" then
		v176.Visible = true
		v177.Visible = false
	else
		v176.Visible = false
		v177.Visible = true
	end
	UpdateMobileButtonScale()
	for _, v181 in pairs(v_u_98) do
		v181:Disconnect()
	end
	v_u_98 = {}
	if v_u_97 then
		v180.Visible = true
		v180.TextLabel.Text = v_u_97.Name
		ConnectButtonEvents(v180, v_u_97)
	else
		v180.Visible = false
	end
	if v_u_96 then
		v179.Visible = true
		v179.TextLabel.Text = v_u_96.Name
		ConnectButtonEvents(v179, v_u_96)
	else
		v179.Visible = false
	end
	if v_u_95 then
		v178.Visible = true
		v178.TextLabel.Text = v_u_95.Name
		ConnectButtonEvents(v178, v_u_95)
	else
		v178.Visible = false
	end
	debug.profileend()
	v_u_1.RefreshButtonStyles()
	debug.profileend()
end

			v186.ImageLabel.Image = v_u_22[p184]

		end

		getButtonInfo(p182).Gui = v186

		v186.Visible = true
	end
end

		v197 = v_u_24[p193]

function v_u_1.HideButton(p200) -- name: HideButton
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_192
	debug.profilebegin("HideButtons")
	if #v_u_1.ActiveButtons > 0 then
		for v201 = #v_u_1.ActiveButtons, 1, -1 do
			if v_u_1.ActiveButtons[v201].Name ~= p200 then
				continue
			end
			local v202 = v_u_1.ActiveButtons[v201]
			RemoveButton(v202)
			if v_u_192[v202.Key] == v202.Name then
				v_u_192[v202.Key] = nil
			end
			table.remove(v_u_1.ActiveButtons, v201)
			sortMobileButtons()
			UpdatePrompts()
		end
	end
	debug.profileend()
end

	end
end

function v_u_1.Interactions.QuickExit(p51)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_12
	local v52 = p51.PrimaryPart:FindFirstChild("ExitLocation")
	if v52 then
		local v53 = v_u_19
		local v54
		if v53 then
			v54 = v_u_2.Character:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(v53:GetPivot())
		else
			v54 = v53
		end
		local v55 = v_u_12:NextNumber() - 0.5
		local v56 = v52.WorldCFrame
		local v57 = v55 * 5
		local v58 = v56 + Vector3.new(v57, 0, 0)
		v_u_2.Character:PivotTo(v58)
		if v53 then
			v53:PivotTo(v58 * v54)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_1.Interactions.CanBeBagged(p59)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v60 = v_u_3.InventoryHandler.GetCurrentlyEquippedClass()
	if v60 and (v60.Model and v60.Model:HasTag("ItemBag")) then
		v60.Tool:BagItem(p59)
	else
		local v61 = nil
		for _, v62 in pairs(v_u_2.Inventory:GetChildren()) do
			if not v62:HasTag("ItemBag") then
				continue
			end
			v61 = v62
		end
		if v61 then
			local v63 = p59:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if v63 then
				v63 = p59.Head:FindFirstChild("KidCrying")
			end
			if v_u_3.Events.RequestBagStoreItem:InvokeServer(v61, p59) and v63 then
				local v64 = v_u_3.Sound.Play
				local v65 = {
					["Replicate"] = true,
					["ReplicationProperties"] = nil,
					["ReplicationProperties"] = {
						["Position"] = p59.Head.Position
					}
				}
				v64("KidInBag", v65)
			end
		end
	end
end

		end
	end
end

function DoGamblerParticles(p75, p76) -- name: DoGamblerParticles
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local v_u_77 = v_u_8.Assets.Particles.GamblerChestParticles:Clone()
	if p75 and p75:FindFirstChild("Main") then
		v_u_77.Parent = workspace.Particles
		v_u_77:PivotTo(p75.Main:GetPivot())
	end
	if p76 == "Bad" then
		for _, v78 in pairs(v_u_77:GetDescendants()) do
			if v78.Name ~= "Roll6" then
				continue
			end
			v78:Destroy()
		end
	else
		for _, v79 in pairs(v_u_77:GetDescendants()) do
			if v79.Name ~= "Roll1" then
				continue
			end
			v79:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, v_u_80 in pairs(v_u_77:GetDescendants()) do
		if not v_u_80:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			continue
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_80
			task.wait(v_u_80:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0)
			if v_u_80:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") then
				v_u_80.Enabled = true
				task.spawn(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_80
					wait(v_u_80:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
					v_u_80.Enabled = false
				end)
			end
			if v_u_80:GetAttribute("EmitCount") then
				v_u_80:Emit(v_u_80:GetAttribute("EmitCount"))
			end
		end)
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_77
		wait(3.5)
		if v_u_77 then
			v_u_77:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end
v_u_3.Events.GamblerParticles:Connect(DoGamblerParticles)
function ChestOpened(p81, p82) -- name: ChestOpened
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	if p81:GetAttribute("Locked") then
		if p81:GetAttribute("LockedMessage") then
			v_u_3.Events.SetPopUpMessage:Fire(p81:GetAttribute("LockedMessage"), "warning")
		end
		return
	elseif p81:GetAttribute("LocalOpened") then
		return
	else
		p81:SetAttribute("LocalOpened", true)
		local v83 = v_u_2.UserId
		p81:SetAttribute(math.abs(v83) .. "Opened", true)
		p81.PrimaryPart.ProximityAttachment:Destroy()
		p81:RemoveTag("Interaction")
		if p81:GetAttribute("ThanksgivingChest") then
			v_u_3.ThanksgivingChestClient.OpenChest(p81, p82)
			v_u_3.Sound.Play("LidReveal")
			return
		elseif p81:GetAttribute("ChristmasPresent") then
			v_u_3.ChristmasPresentClient.OpenChest(p81, p82)
			return
		elseif p81:GetAttribute("RandomBox") then
			v_u_3.GamblerChestClient.OpenChest(p81, p82)
			return
		elseif p81:HasTag("HardModeCrate") then
			v_u_3.ResearchOutpostClient.OpenCrate(p81, p82)
		else
			if not p82 then
				v_u_3.Sound.Play("ChestToggle")
				v_u_3.Events.RequestOpenItemChest:FireServer(p81)
				for _ = 1, p81:GetAttribute("DropsCandy") or 0 do
					v_u_3.CandyClient.SpawnCandy({
						["CFrame"] = p81:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
					}, "HalloweenChest")
				end
				v_u_1.HasOpenedChest = true
				if v_u_3.TutorialClient.ChestTutorialActive then
					v_u_3.TutorialClient.ChestTutorialActive = false
					for _, v84 in pairs(v_u_3.MapDrawClient.TutorialCircles) do
						v84.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
			local v85 = p81.ChestLid:GetPivot()
			p81.ChestLid:PivotTo(v85 * CFrame.Angles(-1.7453292519943295, 0, 0))
			if p81:FindFirstChild("Highlight") then
				p81.Highlight:Destroy()
			end
			if not p82 and (p81:FindFirstChild("Platform") and p81.Platform:FindFirstChild("BG")) then
				p81.Platform.BG:Emit(p81.Platform.BG:GetAttribute("EmitCount"))
				p81.Platform.Front:Emit(p81.Platform.Front:GetAttribute("EmitCount"))
				if v_u_2.Character and v_u_2.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
					local v86 = v_u_3.Sound.Play
					local v87 = {
						["Volume"] = 0.85,
						["Replicate"] = true,
						["ReplicationProperties"] = nil,
						["ReplicationProperties"] = {
							["Instance"] = nil,
							["Volume"] = 0.35,
							["Instance"] = v_u_2.Character.Head
						}
					}
					v86("Chest6Open", v87)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_1.CheckCollectCurrency(p_u_100, _) -- name: CheckCollectCurrency
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	if not p_u_100:GetAttribute("Destroyed") then
		if p_u_100:GetAttribute("QueuedToTake") then
			return true
		end
		if p_u_100:HasTag("Coins") then
			p_u_100:SetAttribute("QueuedToTake", true)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_100
				v_u_3.FlowerAndCoinsClient.PickupCoins(p_u_100)
			end)
			return true
		end
		if p_u_100:HasTag("Flower") then
			p_u_100:SetAttribute("QueuedToTake", true)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_100
				v_u_3.FlowerAndCoinsClient.PullFlower(p_u_100)
				p_u_100:Destroy()
				v_u_3.Events.RequestPickFlower:InvokeServer(p_u_100)
			end)
			return true
		end
		if p_u_100:GetAttribute("Diamonds") then
			p_u_100:SetAttribute("QueuedToTake", true)
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_100
				v_u_3.DiamondsClient.DiamondEffect(p_u_100)
			end)
			v_u_3.Events.RequestTakeDiamonds:FireServer(p_u_100)
			p_u_100:Destroy()
			return true
		end
		if p_u_100:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "HalloweenCandy" then
			p_u_100:SetAttribute("QueuedToTake", true)
			v_u_3.CandyClient.TakeClient(p_u_100)
			return true
		end
		if p_u_100:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "ChristmasCandyCane" then
			p_u_100:SetAttribute("QueuedToTake", true)
			v_u_3.CandyCaneClient.TakeClient(p_u_100)
			return true
		end
	end
end
function PreOpenedChestAdded(p101) -- name: PreOpenedChestAdded
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	if (p101:GetAttribute(v_u_2.UserId .. "Opened") or p101:GetAttribute("ChestEmpty") and not p101:GetAttribute("ChristmasPresent")) and not p101:GetAttribute("LocalOpened") then
		ChestOpened(p101, true)
	end
end
task.spawn(function()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	v_u_3.Utility.ForAllTagged("PreOpenedChest", PreOpenedChestAdded)
end)

function v_u_1.GetFocusItem(p102, p103) -- name: GetFocusItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_20
	if v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
		if v_u_19 then
			return v_u_19, "Dragging"
		end
		local v104, v105 = CheckMouseTarget(p103)
		if v104 then
			return v104, v105
		end
		if v_u_20 and not p102 then
			return v_u_20, "LastTapped"
		end
	end
end
function IsToolDowngrade(p106, p107) -- name: IsToolDowngrade
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v108 = p107 and v_u_3.Utility.IsToolWorse or v_u_3.Utility.IsToolDowngrade
	local v109 = p106:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Armour"
	if not (v109 or p107) then
		for _, v110 in pairs(v_u_2.Inventory:GetChildren()) do
			if not v_u_3.Utility.ToolReplaces(v110, p106) then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end
	end
	local v111 = v109 and p106:GetAttribute("ArmourSlot") or p106:GetAttribute("LockedHotbarSlot")
	if v111 then
		if v109 then
			for _, v112 in pairs(v_u_2.Armour:GetChildren()) do
				if v112:GetAttribute("ArmourSlot") ~= v111 or not v108(v112, p106) then
					continue
				end
				return true
			end
		else
			for _, v113 in pairs(v_u_2.Inventory:GetChildren()) do
				if v113:GetAttribute("LockedHotbarSlot") ~= v111 or not v108(v113, p106) then
					continue
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	else
		if p106:GetAttribute("UniqueToolType") then
			local v114 = p106:GetAttribute("UniqueToolType")
			for _, v115 in pairs(v_u_2.Inventory:GetChildren()) do
				if v115:GetAttribute("UniqueToolType") ~= v114 or not v108(v115, p106) then
					continue
				end
				return true
			end
		end
		return
	end
end
function IsToolUnique(p116) -- name: IsToolUnique
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v117 = v_u_2.Inventory:FindFirstChild(p116.Name)
	if v117 and (v117:GetAttribute("OnePerPlayer") or p116:GetAttribute("OnePerPlayer")) then
		return true
	end
	if v117 and (v117:GetAttribute("LockedHotbarSlot") or p116:GetAttribute("LockedHotbarSlot")) then
		return true
	end
	local v118 = p116:GetAttribute("ToolName")
	if v118 then
		for _, v119 in pairs(v_u_2.Inventory:GetChildren()) do
			if v119:GetAttribute("ToolName") ~= v118 or not (v119:GetAttribute("OneToolPerPlayer") or p116:GetAttribute("OneToolPerPlayer")) then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end
	end
end
function AttemptHotbarItem(p_u_120) -- name: AttemptHotbarItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_1
	if v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
		if v_u_2:GetAttribute("Class") == "Brawler" and (p_u_120:GetAttribute("ToolName") == "Firearm" or p_u_120:GetAttribute("ToolName") == "ThrownWeapon") and p_u_120.Name ~= "Air Rifle" then
			v_u_3.Events.SetPopUpMessage:Fire("Brawler class can\'t use ranged weapons", "warning")
			return
		elseif v_u_2:GetAttribute("Class") == "Woodsman" and (p_u_120:GetAttribute("ToolName") == "GenericAxe" or p_u_120:GetAttribute("ToolName") == "Chainsaw") and (p_u_120.Name ~= "Woodsman\'s Axe" and p_u_120.Name ~= "Admin Axe") then
			v_u_3.Events.SetPopUpMessage:Fire("Woodsman class can only use their own axe", "warning")
			return
		elseif p_u_120:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Tool" then
			if p_u_120:GetAttribute("Owner") and p_u_120:GetAttribute("Owner") ~= v_u_2.UserId then
				return
			elseif IsToolDowngrade(p_u_120) then
				v_u_3.Events.SetPopUpMessage:Fire("You already have a tool better than this", "warning")
				return
			elseif IsToolUnique(p_u_120) then
				v_u_3.Events.SetPopUpMessage:Fire("You already have this tool", "warning")
			else
				if p_u_120 == v_u_19 then
					v_u_3.Events.StopDraggingItem:Fire()
				end
				if p_u_120:GetAttribute("FloatingPotion") then
					v_u_3.CauldronClient.TakePotion(p_u_120)
				end
				if not v_u_1.CheckCollectCurrency(p_u_120, "Hotbar") then
					local v_u_121 = IsToolDowngrade(p_u_120, true)
					local v_u_122 = p_u_120.Parent
					p_u_120.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.TempStorage
					task.spawn(function()
						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_120, (copy) v_u_122, (copy) v_u_121
						local v123 = v_u_3.Events.RequestHotbarItem:InvokeServer(p_u_120)
						if v123 and v123.Success then
							v_u_3.Sound.Play("BagGet", {
								["Duplicate"] = true,
								["PitchShift"] = 1
							})
							if v_u_121 then
								v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("This item is worse", "warning")
							end
							if p_u_120.Name == "Basketball" or p_u_120:GetAttribute("AutoEquip") then
								task.delay(0.1, function()
									-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (ref) p_u_120
									v_u_3.InventoryHandler.RequestEquipItem(p_u_120)
								end)
							end
						elseif p_u_120.Parent ~= nil then
							p_u_120.Parent = v_u_122
							return
						end
					end)
					return true
				end
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
v_u_1.AttemptHotbarItem = AttemptHotbarItem

function AttemptConsumeItem(p_u_135) -- name: AttemptConsumeItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
		if p_u_135:GetAttribute("Owner") and p_u_135:GetAttribute("Owner") ~= v_u_2.UserId then
			return
		else
			local v_u_136
			if p_u_135.Name == "Fuel Canister" or p_u_135.Name == "Oil Barrel" then
				v_u_136 = v_u_2:GetAttribute("Class") == "Pyromaniac"
			else
				v_u_136 = false
			end
			if v_u_136 and v_u_2:GetAttribute("FlamethrowerFuel") >= 100 then
				v_u_3.Events.SetPopUpMessage:Fire("your fuel is full", "warning")
				return
			elseif p_u_135:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Item" or p_u_135:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Tool" then
				if p_u_135:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Tool" and p_u_135:GetAttribute("AmmoType") then
					return
				elseif v_u_2:GetAttribute("Class") == "Bunny" and p_u_135:GetAttribute("HasMeat") then
					v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("Bunny class can\'t eat meat", "easter")
				else
					local v137 = false
					local v138 = false
					if p_u_135:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("RestoreHealth") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("RifleAmmo") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("AmmoType") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("RevolverAmmo") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("ShotgunAmmo") or v_u_136))))) then
						local v_u_139 = p_u_135:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") and true or v137
						local v_u_140 = (p_u_135:GetAttribute("RifleAmmo") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("RevolverAmmo") or (p_u_135:GetAttribute("ShotgunAmmo") or p_u_135:GetAttribute("AmmoType")))) and true or v138
						local v_u_141 = p_u_135.Parent
						p_u_135.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.TempStorage
						task.spawn(function()
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_135, (copy) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_139, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_140, (copy) v_u_136
							local v142 = v_u_3.Events.RequestConsumeItem:InvokeServer(p_u_135)
							if v142 and v142.Success then
								if v_u_139 then
									local v143 = v_u_3.Sound.Play
									local v144 = {
										["Volume"] = 0.2,
										["Replicate"] = true,
										["Duplicate"] = true,
										["ReplicationProperties"] = nil,
										["ReplicationProperties"] = {
											["Instance"] = nil,
											["Volume"] = 0.15,
											["Instance"] = v_u_2.Character.Head
										}
									}
									v143("Eat", v144)
									return
								elseif v_u_140 then
									v_u_3.Sound.Play("AmmoTake", {
										["Duplicate"] = true
									})
								elseif v_u_136 then
									v_u_3.Sound.Play("FuelGet", {
										["Duplicate"] = true
									})
								end
							else
								p_u_135.Parent = v_u_141
								return
							end
						end)
						return true
					end
				end
			else
				return
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
v_u_1.AttemptConsumeItem = AttemptConsumeItem
function FindGrassBlock(p145) -- name: FindGrassBlock
	local v146 = RaycastParams.new()
	v146.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Map.Ground, workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Snow") }
	v146.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	v146.IgnoreWater = true
	local v147 = workspace:Raycast(p145, Vector3.new(0, -55, 0), v146)
	if v147 then
		return v147.Position, v147
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function AttemptPlantItem(p_u_148) -- name: AttemptPlantItem
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
		if p_u_148:GetAttribute("Owner") and p_u_148:GetAttribute("Owner") ~= v_u_2.UserId then
			return
		elseif p_u_148:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Item" or p_u_148:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "Tool" then
			if p_u_148:HasTag("Acorn") then
				v_u_3.TreeRootClient.PlantAcorn(p_u_148)
				return true
			elseif p_u_148:HasTag("Plantable") then
				local v_u_149 = FindGrassBlock(p_u_148.PrimaryPart.Position)
				if v_u_149 then
					local v150 = 40
					if p_u_148.Name == "Giant Sapling" then
						v150 = v150 * 1.3
					end
					if not workspace.Map.Campground.MainFire.PrimaryPart or (workspace.Map.Campground.MainFire.PrimaryPart.Position - v_u_149).Magnitude >= v150 then
						local v_u_151 = p_u_148.Parent
						p_u_148.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.TempStorage
						task.spawn(function()
							-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_148, (copy) v_u_149, (copy) v_u_151
							local v152 = v_u_3.Events.RequestPlantItem:InvokeServer(p_u_148, v_u_149)
							if not (v152 and v152.Success) then
								p_u_148.Parent = v_u_151
							end
						end)
						return true
					end
					v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("can\'t plant this close to fire", "warning")
				end
			else
				return
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function AttemptUseGoldTrimKit(p_u_161) -- name: AttemptUseGoldTrimKit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_8
	if v_u_3.PlayerHandler.Alive then
		if not p_u_161:GetAttribute("Owner") or p_u_161:GetAttribute("Owner") == v_u_2.UserId then
			if p_u_161:GetAttribute("GoldTrimKit") then
				local v_u_162 = nil
				local v163 = p_u_161:GetAttribute("GoldTrimKit")
				if v163 == "Tool" then
					v_u_162 = v_u_3.InventoryHandler.GetCurrentlyEquipped()
					if not v_u_162 then
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("You must equip a tool to gold trim", "warning")
						return
					end
					if v_u_162:GetAttribute("GoldTrimmed") then
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("This tool is already gold trimmed", "warning")
						return
					end
					if not v_u_162:GetAttribute("CanTrim") then
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("You can\'t gold trim this tool", "warning")

					end

					v_u_162 = GetBodyArmour()
					if not v_u_162 then
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("You aren\'t wearing any armour to gold trim", "warning")
						return
					end
					if v_u_162:GetAttribute("GoldTrimmed") then
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("Your armour is already gold trimmed", "warning")
						return
					end
					if not v_u_162:GetAttribute("CanTrim") then
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("You can\'t gold trim this armour", "warning")
						return
					end
				end
				local v_u_164 = p_u_161.Parent
				p_u_161.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.TempStorage
				local v_u_165 = nil
				task.spawn(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_161, (ref) v_u_162, (copy) v_u_164, (ref) v_u_165, (ref) v_u_8

					end

		return
	end
end
function CheckPrimaryInteraction(_, p168) -- name: CheckPrimaryInteraction
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p168 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		local v169 = v_u_1.GetFocusItem()
		if v169 then
			if v_u_1.CheckCollectCurrency(v169, "Take") then
				return
			end
			if AttemptHotbarItem(v169) then
				return
			end
			if AttemptEquipArmour(v169) then
				return
			end
			if AttemptConsumeItem(v169) then
				return
			end
			if AttemptUseGoldTrimKit(v169) then
				return
			end
			if AttemptPlantItem(v169) then
				return
			end
			if AttemptPlantSeeds(v169) then
				return
			end
		end
	end
end
v_u_1.CheckPrimaryInteraction = CheckPrimaryInteraction

v7:BindActionAtPriority("DraggingBegin", function(_, p170)
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13
	if p170 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		v_u_13 = true
	else
		v_u_13 = false
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 10, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)

	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_13

v_u_6.TouchTapInWorld:Connect(function(p171, p172)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_20
	if p172 then
		return
	elseif not v_u_3.PingClient.PingActive then
		local v173 = workspace.CurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(p171.X, p171.Y)
		local v174, v175 = v_u_1.GetFocusItem(true, v173)
		if not v_u_3.StructurePlacementClient.PlacementActive and (v175 == "MouseTarget" or v175 == "TapZone") then
			v_u_13 = true
			local v176 = v174:GetAttribute("Interaction")
			if v_u_1.Interactions[v176] then
				v_u_21 = "Touch"
				v_u_1.ProcessInteraction(v174, v176, nil, "Touch")
			end
		end
		local v177 = v_u_3.InventoryHandler.GetCurrentlyEquipped()
		if v175 ~= "MouseTarget" and v175 ~= "TapZone" then
			if v177 == nil or v177.Name ~= "Bandage" and (v177.Name ~= "MedKit" and not v177:GetAttribute("Automatic")) then
				if not v177 or (not v_u_3.FirstPersonModule.IsVisible() or v177:GetAttribute("ToolName") ~= "Firearm") then
					v_u_3.InventoryHandler.ActivateTool(v173)
				end
			else
				print("reject tap")
			end
		end
		v_u_20 = v174
	end
end)

function StartDragging(p_u_188) -- name: StartDragging
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_187, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_5

			else
				local v191 = p_u_188:GetAttribute("Owner")
				if v191 == nil or v191 == v_u_2.UserId then

					end

					v_u_192.Responsiveness = 50

					v_u_193.MaxTorque = (1 / 0)

					local v195 = p_u_188:GetPivot()

						v197:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)

					local v_u_199 = nil
					local function v_u_201(p_u_200) -- name: cancelDragging
						-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_192, (copy) v_u_193, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) p_u_188, (ref) v_u_198, (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_199
						v_u_192:Destroy()

							v_u_201(p202)

end

function MakeHoverLabel(p206) -- name: MakeHoverLabel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_18
	local v207 = v_u_8.Assets.Billboards.HoverLabel:Clone()
	v207.ItemName.Text = p206:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or p206.Name
	local v208 = ""
	v207.Adornee = p206.PrimaryPart.DraggingAttachment
	if p206:GetAttribute("BurnFuel") and p206:GetAttribute("BurnFuel") > 5 then
		for _ = 1, p206:GetAttribute("BurnFuel") >= 500 and 4 or (p206:GetAttribute("BurnFuel") >= 270 and 3 or (p206:GetAttribute("BurnFuel") >= 90 and 2 or 1)) do
			v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\148\165"
		end
	end
	if p206:GetAttribute("SpeedBoost") then
		v208 = v208 .. "\226\154\161"
	elseif p206:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") and p206:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") > 0 then
		for _ = 1, p206:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") >= 100 and 4 or (p206:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") >= 70 and 3 or (p206:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") >= 30 and 2 or (p206:GetAttribute("RestoreHunger") >= 0 and 1 or 1))) do
			v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\141\180"
		end
	end
	if p206:GetAttribute("EasterEggId") then
		v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\144\176"
	end
	if p206:GetAttribute("Scrappable") then
		for _ = 1, p206:GetAttribute("Scrappable") >= 8 and 4 or (p206:GetAttribute("Scrappable") >= 5 and 3 or (p206:GetAttribute("Scrappable") >= 3 and 2 or 1)) do
			v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\148\169"
		end
	end
	if p206:HasTag("Flower") then
		v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\140\186"
	end
	if p206:HasTag("PotionIngredient") then
		v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\167\170"
	end
	if p206:HasTag("Toy") then
		v208 = v208 .. "\240\159\167\184"
	end
	v207.Emojis.Text = v208
	v207.Parent = p206
	v_u_18 = v207
end

function CheckClickInteraction(_, p210, _) -- name: CheckClickInteraction
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_6
	if v_u_3.StructurePlacementClient.PlacementActive then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	if p210 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		if time() < v_u_22 then
			return
		end
		local v211, v212 = CheckMouseTarget()
		if v211 then
			local v213 = v211:GetAttribute("Interaction")
			if v_u_1.Interactions[v213] then
				v_u_21 = "Mouse"
				v_u_1.ProcessInteraction(v211, v213, nil, "Click")
				if v_u_6.PreferredInput ~= Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad and v212 == "Zone" then
					return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

local v224 = RaycastParams.new()

function GetInteractionFromPart(p225) -- name: GetInteractionFromPart
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v226 = p225.Parent
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		if v226 == nil or v226:GetAttribute("Interaction") then
			break
		end
		v226 = v226.Parent
	end
	if v226 and (v226:GetAttribute("Interaction") and (v226:HasTag("Interaction") and (v_u_3.PlayerHandler.HumanoidRootPart and ((v_u_3.PlayerHandler.HumanoidRootPart.Position - v226:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude <= v_u_3.GlobalSettings.InteractionDistance + 1 and (v226:GetAttribute("Owner") == nil or v226:GetAttribute("Owner") == v_u_2.UserId))))) then
		if v226:GetAttribute("Interaction") == "CanBeBagged" then
			local v227 = v_u_3.InventoryHandler.GetCurrentlyEquipped()
			if v227 == nil or not v227:HasTag("ItemBag") then
				return
			end
		end
		if v226:GetAttribute("InteractOnCooldown") == nil and v226:GetAttribute("NotClickable") == nil then
			return v226
		end
	end
end
local v_u_228 = OverlapParams.new()
v_u_228.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
v_u_228.FilterDescendantsInstances = { workspace.Items, workspace.Map, workspace.Structures }
function CheckGamepadZone() -- name: CheckGamepadZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_228
	local v229 = v_u_2.Character
	if v229 then
		v229 = v_u_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	if v229 then
		local v230 = v229.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
		local v231 = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(v230, Vector3.new(6, 7, 7), v_u_228)
		local v232 = {}
		for _, v233 in pairs(v231) do
			local v234 = GetInteractionFromPart(v233)
			if not v234 then
				continue
			end
			v232[v234] = true
		end
		local v235 = v229.Position
		local v236 = (1 / 0)
		local v237 = nil
		for v238 in pairs(v232) do
			local v239 = (v238:GetPivot().Position - v235).Magnitude
			if v239 >= v236 then
				continue
			end
			v237 = v238
			v236 = v239
		end
		if v237 then
			return v237
		end
	end
end
function CheckTapAssist(p240) -- name: CheckTapAssist
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_228
	if p240 ~= nil then
		local v241 = p240.Position
		local v242 = (1 / 0)
		local v243 = nil
		for _, v244 in pairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(v241, v_u_3.GlobalSettings.MaxTapAssistRadius, v_u_228)) do
			local v245 = GetInteractionFromPart(v244)
			if not v245 then
				continue
			end
			local v246 = v245:GetAttribute("TapAssist")
			if not v246 then
				continue
			end
			local v247 = (v244.Position - v241).Magnitude
			if v247 > v246 or v247 >= v242 then
				continue
			end
			v243 = v245
			v242 = v247
		end
		return v243
	end
end
function UpdateReticle() -- name: UpdateReticle

function NPCAdded(p_u_17) -- name: NPCAdded
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2
	if not v_u_16[p_u_17] then
		v_u_16[p_u_17] = {
			["Events"] = {},
			["AnimTracks"] = {}
		}
		LoadAnimations(p_u_17)

			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_17
				LoadClientHitDetection(p_u_17)
			end)
		end
		local function v18() -- name: considerStart
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_17, (ref) v_u_2
			if p_u_17:GetAttribute("MovementDriver") == v_u_2.UserId and IsDriveableState(p_u_17:GetAttribute("State")) then
				task.spawn(StartMovementDriver, p_u_17)
			end
		end
		local v19 = v_u_16[p_u_17].Events
		local v20 = p_u_17:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MovementDriver")
		table.insert(v19, v20:Connect(v18))
		local v21 = v_u_16[p_u_17].Events
		local v22 = p_u_17:GetAttributeChangedSignal("State")
		table.insert(v21, v22:Connect(v18))
		if p_u_17:GetAttribute("MovementDriver") == v_u_2.UserId and IsDriveableState(p_u_17:GetAttribute("State")) then
			task.spawn(StartMovementDriver, p_u_17)

end

function ShouldJumpOver(p33, p34, p35) -- name: ShouldJumpOver
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v36 = p33.MoveDirection
	if v36.Magnitude < 0.1 then
		return false
	end
	local v37 = v_u_3.CollisionUtility.DefaultParams
	local v38 = p34.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * 0.3
	local v39 = math.max(3, v38) + p35
	local v40 = p34.Position
	local v41 = p33.UseJumpPower and p33.JumpPower ^ 2 / (2 * workspace.Gravity) or p33.JumpHeight
	local v42 = v40.Y - p34.Size.Y / 2 - p33.HipHeight
	local v43 = v40 + v36 * v39
	local v44 = workspace
	local v45 = v43.X
	local v46 = v42 + v41
	local v47 = v43.Z
	local v48 = Vector3.new(v45, v46, v47)
	local v49 = -(v41 + 4)
	local v50 = v44:Raycast(v48, Vector3.new(0, v49, 0), v37)
	if v50 then
		local v51 = v50.Position.Y - v42
		if v51 > 0.4 and v51 < v41 * 0.8 then
			return true
		end
	end
	local v52 = workspace
	local v53 = v40.X
	local v54 = v42 + 0.5
	local v55 = v40.Z
	if not v52:Raycast(Vector3.new(v53, v54, v55), v36 * v39, v37) then
		return false
	end
	local v56 = workspace
	local v57 = v40.X
	local v58 = v42 + v41 * 0.8
	local v59 = v40.Z
	return v56:Raycast(Vector3.new(v57, v58, v59), v36 * v39, v37) == nil
end
function CountPathTurns(p60) -- name: CountPathTurns
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v61 = 0
	local v62 = p60[1]
	if v62 then
		v62 = p60[1].Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
	end
	for v63 = 2, #p60 do
		if v_u_3.CollisionUtility.HasLineOfSight(v62, p60[v63].Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)) then
			continue
		end
		v61 = v61 + 1
		v62 = p60[v63 - 1].Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
	end
	return v61
end

function StartAttackRangeTracking(p153) -- name: StartAttackRangeTracking
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3
	if v_u_2.Character then
		local v154 = p153:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local v155 = p153:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		v_u_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local v156 = p153:FindFirstChild("NPC")
		local v157 = p153:GetAttribute("AttackRange")
		local v158 = p153:GetAttribute("AttackCooldown")
		local v159 = p153:GetAttribute("EffectiveSpeed")
		if not v159 then
			v159 = p153:GetAttribute("RunSpeed")
		end
		while true do
			task.wait()
			v159 = p153:GetAttribute("EffectiveSpeed") or (p153:GetAttribute("RunSpeed") or v159)
			if p153:GetAttribute("ChasingPlayer") ~= v_u_2.UserId or (p153:GetAttribute("Dead") or (p153:GetAttribute("Tamed") or (p153:GetAttribute("State") ~= "Chase" or not v_u_2.Character))) then
				break
			end
			local v160 = v_u_2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not v160 then
				continue
			end
			local v161 = ((v160.Position - v155.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
			local v162 = ((v160.Position - v154.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
			local v163 = v160.Position.Y - v155.Position.Y
			local v164 = math.abs(v163)
			local v165 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			local v166 = p153:GetAttribute("LastAttackTime")
			local v167
			if v161 < v157 or v162 < v157 then
				v167 = v164 < v157 * 1.8
			else
				v167 = false
			end
			local v168 = v165 - v166 < v158
			if p153:GetAttribute("MovementDriver") ~= v_u_2.UserId and v156.WalkSpeed > 0 then
				if v167 then
					local v169 = 1 - math.min(v161, v162) / v157
					local v170 = v_u_2.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed
					v156.WalkSpeed = math.min(v170, v159) * (1 - v169 * 0.25)
				else
					v156.WalkSpeed = v159
				end
			end
			if not v167 or v168 then
				continue
			end
			p153:SetAttribute("LastAttackTime", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
			v_u_3.Events.ClientTriggerNPCAttack:FireServer(p153)
		end
	end
end
function LoadClientHitDetection(p_u_171) -- name: LoadClientHitDetection
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_16
	local v_u_172 = false
	local function v173() -- name: checkStartChasing
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_171, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_172
		if p_u_171:GetAttribute("RangedUnit") then
			return
		elseif p_u_171:GetAttribute("Tamed") then
			return
		elseif p_u_171:GetAttribute("State") == "Chase" then
			if p_u_171:GetAttribute("ChasingPlayer") == v_u_2.UserId and not v_u_172 then
				v_u_172 = true

				v_u_172 = false
			end
		end
	end
	local v174 = v_u_16[p_u_171].Events
	local v175 = p_u_171:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ChasingPlayer")
	table.insert(v174, v175:Connect(v173))
	if p_u_171:GetAttribute("ChasingPlayer") == v_u_2.UserId then
		v173()
	end
	p_u_171:GetAttributeChangedSignal("State"):Connect(v173)
end

function ReplaceLandmarkIcon(p39, p40) -- name: ReplaceLandmarkIcon
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_16
	v_u_33[p39].Image = p40
	if v_u_16[p39] then
		for _, v41 in pairs(v_u_16[p39]) do
			v41.Image = p40
		end
	end
end
v_u_3.Events.ReplaceLandmarkIcon:Connect(ReplaceLandmarkIcon)
function worldToCell(p42, p43) -- name: worldToCell
	local v44 = (p42 + 1400) / 40
	local v45 = math.floor(v44)
	local v46 = (p43 + 1400) / 40
	return math.floor(v46), v45
end
function cellToWorld(p47, p48) -- name: cellToWorld
	return p48 * 40 - 1400, p47 * 40 - 1400
end
function cellToScale(p49, p50) -- name: cellToScale
	return p50 / 71 + 0.007142857142857143, p49 / 71 + 0.007142857142857143
end
function worldToScale(p51, p52) -- name: worldToScale
	return p51 / 2800 + 0.5, p52 / 2800 + 0.5
end
v_u_1.WorldToScale = worldToScale
function scaleToWorld(p53, p54) -- name: scaleToWorld
	return (p53 - 0.5) * 2800, (p54 - 0.5) * 2800
end
v_u_1.ScaleToWorld = scaleToWorld
function v_u_1.IsSurfaceMapOpen() -- name: IsSurfaceMapOpen
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v55 = MapFrame ~= nil and v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder.Visible
	if v55 then
		v55 = MapFrame.Parent == v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder
	end
	return v55
end
function v_u_1.GetMapFrame() -- name: GetMapFrame
	return MapFrame
end
function v_u_1.HasMap() -- name: HasMap
	return MapModel ~= nil and true or workspace:GetAttribute("MapUnlocked") == true
end
function v_u_1.MapPixelToWorld(p56) -- name: MapPixelToWorld
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3
	if v_u_1.IsSurfaceMapOpen() then
		local v57 = v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder:FindFirstChild("CloseButton")
		if v57 then
			local v58 = (Vector2.new(p56.X, p56.Y) - v57.AbsolutePosition) / v57.AbsoluteSize
			if v58.X >= 0 and (v58.X <= 1 and (v58.Y >= 0 and v58.Y <= 1)) then
				return nil
			end
		end
		local v59 = (Vector2.new(p56.X, p56.Y) - MapFrame.AbsolutePosition) / MapFrame.AbsoluteSize
		if v59.X < 0 or (v59.X > 1 or (v59.Y < 0 or v59.Y > 1)) then
			return nil
		else
			return scaleToWorld(v59.X, v59.Y)
		end
	else
		return nil
	end
end
function ForTilesInRadius(p60, p61) -- name: ForTilesInRadius
	local v62 = p60 ^ 2
	for v63 = 0, 70 do
		for v64 = 0, 70 do
			local v65, v66 = cellToWorld(v63, v64)
			if v65 ^ 2 + v66 ^ 2 > v62 then
				continue
			end
			p61(v63, v64)
		end
	end
end
function UpdateMapRange() -- name: UpdateMapRange
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_12
	local v67 = workspace:GetAttribute("MapRange") + 25
	if v_u_11 < v67 then
		v_u_11 = v67
		ForTilesInRadius(v_u_11, function(p68, p69)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_12
			if v_u_12[p68] and v_u_12[p68][p69] == "Boundary" then
				v_u_12[p68][p69] = "Fog"
			end
		end)
		FullUpdateMap()
	end
end
function PrepareCaveMap() -- name: PrepareCaveMap
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13
	local v70 = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Caves"):WaitForChild("CaveMap")
	local v71 = v70:GetChildren()
	v70:Destroy()
	for _, v72 in pairs(v71) do
		local v73 = v72.Position
		local v74, v75 = worldToCell(v73.X, v73.Z)
		if v_u_13[v74] == nil then
			v_u_13[v74] = {}
		end
		v_u_13[v74][v75] = "Undiscovered"
	end
	FullUpdateCaveMap()
end
function PrepareMap() -- name: PrepareMap
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_11
	local v76 = workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("Biomes")
	if not v76:GetAttribute("BiomesLoaded") then
		v76:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BiomesLoaded"):Wait()
	end
	if v_u_3.GlobalSettings.ChristmasMap then
		MapFrame.Background.Grass.BackgroundColor3 = v_u_7
	end
	v_u_3.BiomesClient.ReloadBiomes()
	local v77 = game.ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("UnlockMap")
	for v78 = 0, 70 do
		local v79 = nil
		for v80 = 0, 71 do
			local v81, v82 = cellToWorld(v78, v80)
			local v83 = v81 ^ 2 + v82 ^ 2
			if v80 <= 70 then
				if v_u_12[v78] == nil then
					v_u_12[v78] = {}
				end
				if v83 > 1988100 then
					v_u_12[v78][v80] = "Boundary"
				elseif v83 <= 11025 or v77 then
					v_u_12[v78][v80] = "Discovered"
				elseif v83 <= v_u_11 then
					v_u_12[v78][v80] = "Fog"
				else
					v_u_12[v78][v80] = "Boundary"
				end
			end
			local v84, v85 = v_u_3.BiomesClient.GetBiomeXZ(v81, v82)
			if v79 ~= nil and (v84 ~= v79.BiomeName or v80 == 71) then
				local v86 = v79.Column
				local v87 = v80 - 1
				local _, v88 = cellToScale(v78, v86)
				cellToScale(v78, v87)
				local v89 = Instance.new("Frame")
				v89.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				v89.BorderSizePixel = 0
				v89.ZIndex = 2
				v89.Parent = MapFrame.Background
				v89.BackgroundColor3 = v79.Biome.GroundColour
				v89.Name = "Biome" .. v78
				local v90 = v87 - v86 + 1
				v89.Size = UDim2.new(v90 / 71, 0, 0.014285714285714285, 0)
				local v91 = cellToScale(v78, v86)
				v89.Position = UDim2.new(v91 - 0.007142857142857143, 0, v88, 0)
				v79 = nil
			end
			if not v84 or v79 ~= nil then
				continue
			end
			v79 = {
				["Column"] = v80,
				["Biome"] = v85,
				["BiomeName"] = v84
			}
		end
	end
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MapRange"):Connect(function()
		UpdateMapRange()
	end)
	UpdateMapRange()
	TrackMapIcons()
	FullUpdateMap()

function UpdateCaveRow(p94) -- name: UpdateCaveRow
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_8
	if v_u_13[p94] then
		local v95 = v_u_27[p94]
		if v95 == nil then
			v95 = {}
			v_u_27[p94] = v95
		end
		local v96 = CaveMapFrame.AbsoluteSize.X / 70
		math.floor(v96)
		local v97 = nil
		local v98 = 1
		for v99 = 0, 71 do
			local v100 = v_u_13[p94][v99]
			if v97 ~= nil and v100 ~= v97.Type then
				local v101 = v97.Column
				local v102 = v99 - 1
				local _, v103 = cellToScale(p94, v101)
				cellToScale(p94, v102)
				local v104 = v95[v98]
				if not v104 then
					v104 = Instance.new("Frame")
					table.insert(v95, v104)
					v104.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
					v104.Name = p94 .. "_" .. v99
					v104.BorderSizePixel = 0
					v104.ZIndex = 5
					v104.Parent = CaveMapFrame.Tiles
				end
				if v97.Type == "Discovered" then
					v104.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124, 124, 124)
				elseif v97.Type == "Boundary" then
					v104.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
				elseif v97.Type == "Fog" then
					v104.BackgroundColor3 = v_u_8
				end
				v98 = v98 + 1
				local v105 = v102 - v101 + 1
				v104.Size = UDim2.new(v105 / 71, 0, 0.014285714285714285, 0)
				local v106 = cellToScale(p94, v101)
				v104.Position = UDim2.new(v106 - 0.007142857142857143, 0, v103, 0)
				v97 = nil
			end
			if not v100 or (v100 == "Undiscovered" or v97 ~= nil) then
				continue
			end
			v97 = {
				["Column"] = v99,
				["Type"] = v100
			}
		end
		while v98 <= #v95 do
			table.remove(v95, v98):Destroy()
		end
	end
end

function UncoverTilesAroundPlayer() -- name: UncoverTilesAroundPlayer
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_3
	local v193 = {}
	local v194 = {}
	local v195 = {}
	local v196 = {}
	for _, v197 in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
		local v198 = v197.Character
		if v198 then
			v198 = v197.Character.PrimaryPart
		end
		if not v198 or IsOffMap(v198.Position) then
			continue
		end
		local v199 = v198.Position
		if v197:GetAttribute("InCave") then
			v199 = v199 - v_u_9
		end
		local v200, v201 = worldToCell(v199.X, v199.Z)
		for v202 = v200 - 4, v200 + 4 do
			for v203 = v201 - 4, v201 + 4 do
				if v197:GetAttribute("InCave") then
					local v204 = v_u_13[v202]
					if v204 then
						v204 = v_u_13[v202][v203]
					end
					if not v204 or v204 ~= "Undiscovered" then
						continue
					end
					local v205, v206 = cellToWorld(v202, v203)
					if (v205 - v199.X) ^ 2 + (v206 - v199.Z) ^ 2 >= 5625 then
						continue
					end
					v194[v202] = true
					v_u_13[v202][v203] = "Discovered"
					table.insert(v195, {
						["Row"] = v202,
						["Col"] = v203
					})
					if not (v_u_19[v202] and v_u_19[v202][v203]) then
						continue
					end
					for _, v207 in pairs(v_u_19[v202][v203]) do
						v207.Visible = true
					end
				else
					local v208 = v_u_12[v202]
					if v208 then
						v208 = v_u_12[v202][v203]
					end
					if not v208 or v208 ~= "Fog" then
						continue
					end
					local v209, v210 = cellToWorld(v202, v203)
					if (v209 - v199.X) ^ 2 + (v210 - v199.Z) ^ 2 >= 5625 then
						continue
					end
					v196[v202] = true
					v_u_12[v202][v203] = "Discovered"
					table.insert(v193, {
						["Row"] = v202,
						["Col"] = v203
					})
					local v211 = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shops"):WaitForChild("Radar")
					if not (v_u_14[v202] and v_u_14[v202][v203]) then
						continue
					end
					for _, v212 in pairs(v_u_14[v202][v203]) do
						local v213 = v212:GetAttribute("StructureName")
						if v213 and v211:GetAttribute((string.gsub(string.gsub(v213, "%d", ""), " ", "_"))) == false then
							v_u_3.Events.FoundLandmark:FireServer(v213)
						end
						v212.Visible = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for v214 in pairs(v196) do
		UpdateRow(v214)
	end
	for v215 in pairs(v194) do
		UpdateCaveRow(v215)
	end
	if #v193 > 0 or #v195 > 0 then
		v_u_3.Events.MapCellsDiscovered:FireServer(v193, v195)
	end
end

function MakeHeadModel(p242, p243) -- name: MakeHeadModel
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_5
	local v244 = Instance.new("Model")
	local v245 = p243.CFrame
	local v246 = p243:Clone()
	v246.Color = v_u_22
	v246.Parent = v244
	v244.PrimaryPart = v246
	local v247 = v246:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
	if v247 and v247.TextureId ~= "" then
		for _, v248 in pairs(v246:GetChildren()) do
			if not v248:IsA("Decal") then
				continue
			end
			v248:Destroy()
		end
		local v249 = v246:Clone()
		v249.Transparency = 0.01
		local v250 = v249:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
		v250.Scale = v250.Scale * 1.01
		v249.Parent = v244
		v247.TextureId = ""
	end
	for _, v251 in pairs(p242:GetChildren()) do
		local v252 = v251:IsA("Accessory")
		if v252 then
			v252 = v251:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		end
		if not v252 then
			continue
		end
		v252:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
	end
	for _, v253 in pairs(v244:GetDescendants()) do
		if v253:IsA("BasePart") then
			v253.CFrame = v245:ToObjectSpace(v253.CFrame)
			v253.Anchored = true
		elseif not (v253:IsA("DataModelMesh") or (v253:IsA("Decal") or v253:IsA("SurfaceAppearance"))) then
			v253:Destroy()
		end
		if not v253.Parent then
			continue
		end
		for _, v254 in pairs(v_u_5:GetTags(v253)) do
			v_u_5:RemoveTag(v253, v254)
		end
	end
	return v244
end

end

function GetHeadLook(p275, p276) -- name: GetHeadLook
