	for _, v280 in pairs(p275:GetChildren()) do
		local v281 = v280:IsA("Accessory")
		if v281 then
			v281 = v280:FindFirstChild("Handle")

		if v281 then
			v281 = v281:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")

function WatchAvatarHead(p282) -- name: WatchAvatarHead
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_232
	local v283 = nil
	while p282.Parent do
		local v284 = p282.Character
		local v285
		if v284 then
			v285 = v284:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		else
			v285 = v284
		end
		local v286
		if v284 then
			v286 = v284:FindFirstChild("Head")
		else
			v286 = v284
		end
		local v287
		if v286 and (v285 and (v285.Health > 0 and v284.Parent)) then
			v287 = GetHeadLook(v284, v286)
			if v287 == v283 then
				v287 = v283
			else
				v_u_21[p282] = MakeHeadModel(v284, v286)
				local v288 = { v_u_20, v_u_232 }
				for _, v289 in pairs(v288) do
					if not v289[p282] then
						continue
					end
					ShowAvatarHead(v289[p282], p282)
				end
			end
		else
			v287 = v283
		end
		task.wait(2)
		v283 = v287
	end
end

function v_u_1.GetIconZone(p306) -- name: GetIconZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	local v307, v308 = scaleToWorld(p306.Position.X.Scale, p306.Position.Y.Scale)
	local v309 = v307 * v307 + v308 * v308
	local v310 = math.sqrt(v309)
	for v311 = 1, #v_u_10 do
		if v310 > v_u_10[v311] then
			continue
		end
		return v311
	end
	return #v_u_10
end

function OpenMap(p318) -- name: OpenMap
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_3
	MapOpen = true
	if v_u_31 then
		return
	elseif v_u_1.HasMap() or (p318 or v_u_3.MazeMapClient.IsActive()) then
		v_u_3.Sound.Play("PosterOpen")
		v_u_3.Interface.TopRight.Frame.Map.TutorialLabel.Visible = false
		if MapModel then
			MapModel.Board.BoardPart.SurfaceGui.Notif.Visible = false
		end
		if p318 or MainFire and (MainFire:GetAttribute("FuelRemaining") or 0) > 0 then
			MapFrame.Parent = v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder
		end
		if v_u_3.MazeMapClient.IsActive() then
			v_u_3.MazeMapClient.SetOpen(true)
			return
		elseif IsInCave() then
			v_u_3.Interface.CaveMapHolder.Visible = true
		else
			v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder.Visible = true
		end
	else
		return
	end
end
v_u_1.OpenMap = OpenMap

function CloseMap() -- name: CloseMap

		v_u_31 = false
		v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder.AliensRevenge.AlienScanButton.Visible = false
		v_u_3.AlienScannerClient.CloseScannerView()

			MapFrame.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.TempStorage
		end
	end
	if MapModel then
		MapFrame.Parent = MapSurfaceGui
	else
		MapFrame.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.TempStorage
	end
	v_u_3.Interface.MapHolder.Visible = false
	v_u_3.Interface.CaveMapHolder.Visible = false
	v_u_3.MazeMapClient.SetOpen(false)
	for _, v319 in pairs(v_u_23) do
		v319.Hovered = false
	end
	v_u_3.Sound.Play("CloseButton")
	v_u_3.Events.MapClosed:Fire()

			else
				v91 = p65
			end
			v90.Text = v91
			local v92 = string.gsub(p64, "[Ff][Ll][Aa][Mm][Ee]", "Offering")
			v_u_67.TextLabel.Text = v92
		end
		local v93 = p62:GetAttribute("Rarity")
		local v94 = v93 and v_u_21[v93] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		if (v_u_68 == "Furniture" or (v_u_68 == "Tools" or v_u_68 == "Toys")) and p66 <= 0 then
			v_u_67.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v_u_20
		else
			v_u_67.TextLabel.TextColor3 = v94
		end
		local v95 = v_u_67:FindFirstChild("Glow")
		if v95 then
			v95.ImageColor3 = v94
		end
		if v_u_8 and v_u_8 ~= p62 then
			v_u_8:SetAttribute("Selected", nil)
			v_u_9 = {}
		end
		p62:SetAttribute("Selected", true)
		v_u_8 = p62
		v_u_9.folder = p62
		v_u_9.image = p63
		v_u_9.name = p64
		v_u_9.desc = p65
		v_u_9.stock = p66
	else
		v_u_67.Visible = false
		if v_u_8 then

		end
		v_u_8 = nil

	end
end
function RefreshMenu(p_u_96) -- name: RefreshMenu

	local v_u_97 = v_u_7:FindFirstChild(p_u_96.Name .. "ScrollingFrame")

					v_u_104.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = v107.Colour or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
					v_u_104.DescriptionLabel.Text = v_u_102

			if p_u_96.Name == "Furniture" then

			if p_u_96.Name == "Furniture" and v_u_99 <= 0 then

			elseif p_u_96.Name == "Tools" and v_u_99 - v_u_100 <= 0 then
				v_u_104.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = v_u_20
			elseif p_u_96.Name == "Tools" then
				local v122 = v_u_3.Databases.RewardsDatabase.Tools[v_u_98.Name] or {}
				v_u_104.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = v122.Colour or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			elseif p_u_96.Name == "Toys" then
				v_u_104.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = v_u_99 - v_u_100 <= 0 and v_u_20 or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			elseif v121 and v_u_21[v121] then

			end
			if v_u_98:GetAttribute("Selected") then

				v_u_104.SelectedCornerDetails.Visible = true
				v_u_104.UIStroke.Thickness = 0.036
				v_u_104.UIStroke.Transparency = 0
				local _ = (v_u_98:GetAttribute("Quantity") or 0) - (v_u_98:GetAttribute("ServerWithdrawn") or 0)
			else

				v_u_104.UIStroke.Thickness = 0.012

			end

			v_u_5[v_u_98] = v_u_104
		end
	end
	local v123 = 0
	for _, v124 in pairs(p_u_96:GetChildren()) do
		if v124.Name == "Toy Shelf" or v124:GetAttribute("Equipped") == false then

		end
		v123 = v123 + 1
	end
	if v_u_6 == p_u_96.Name and v123 == 0 then

		local v126 = v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(p_u_96.Name)

			v_u_7.EmptyState.Visible = false

end

function BottomMenuSetup() -- name: BottomMenuSetup
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2
	local v_u_140 = {}
	local function v_u_148(p141) -- name: setEquippedButton
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_18
		v_u_6 = p141
		local v142 = nil
		for _, v143 in pairs(v_u_140) do
			if v143.Name == p141 then
				v143.TextLabel.TextTransparency = 0
				v143.Icon.ImageTransparency = 0
				v143.Icon.UIGradient.Enabled = false
				v142 = v143
			else
				v143.TextLabel.TextTransparency = 0.5
				v143.Icon.ImageTransparency = 0.5
				v143.Icon.UIGradient.Enabled = true
			end
		end
		v_u_7.Header.HeaderTitle.Text = v142.TextLabel.Text == "Upgrade Flames" and "Offerings" or v142.TextLabel.Text
		v_u_7.Header.HeaderDescription.Text = v_u_18[p141] or ""
		v_u_7.Header.ImageLabel.Image = v142.Icon.Image
		v_u_7.Header.Visible = true
		for _, v144 in pairs(v_u_7:GetChildren()) do
			if not string.find(v144.Name, "ScrollingFrame") then
				continue
			end
			local v145 = v144.Name:gsub("ScrollingFrame", "")
			if string.find(v144.Name, p141) then
				if v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(p141) and v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(p141).Visible then
					v144.Visible = false
					v_u_7.EmptyState.Visible = true
					for _, v146 in pairs(v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(p141):GetChildren()) do
						v146.Visible = true
					end
				else
					v144.Visible = true
					v_u_7.EmptyState.Visible = false
				end
			else
				v144.Visible = false
				if not (v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(v145) and v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(v145).Visible) then
					continue
				end
				for _, v147 in pairs(v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(v145):GetChildren()) do
					v147.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
		UpdateFurnitureCoinDisplay()
	end
	local v149 = v_u_7.TabNavigator.Tabs
	for _, v_u_150 in pairs(v149:GetChildren()) do
		if not v_u_150:IsA("TextButton") then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v_u_140, v_u_150)
		v_u_150.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_150, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_148
			if v_u_150.Name ~= v_u_6 then
				v_u_3.Sound.Play("KeyPress")
				SetPreview()
				local v151 = v_u_2.RewardsInventory:FindFirstChild(v_u_150.Name)
				local v152 = v_u_7.EmptyState:FindFirstChild(v_u_150.Name)
				if v152 then
					v152.Visible = not v151 or #v151:GetChildren() == 0
				end
				v_u_148(v_u_150.Name)
				if v151 then
					RefreshMenu(v151)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	v_u_148(v_u_6)
end
function PreviewButtonsSetup() -- name: PreviewButtonsSetup
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_12
	v_u_7.PreviewFrame.UseButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_3, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_12
		if v_u_8 then
			local v153 = v_u_8.Parent.Name
			if v153 == "Furniture" then
				local v154 = v_u_8
				if (v154:GetAttribute("Stock") or 0) <= 0 then
					v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("none left", "warning")
					return
				else
					local v155 = v154:GetAttribute("Price") or 0
					if v_u_2:GetAttribute("DecoratorGamePass") then
						local v156 = v155 * 0.75
						v155 = math.ceil(v156)
					end
					if v155 <= v_u_3.FlowerAndCoinsClient.CoinAmount or v155 <= (v_u_2:GetAttribute("Coins") or 0) then
						local v157 = v_u_3.FlowerAndCoinsClient
						v157.CoinAmount = v157.CoinAmount - v155
						v_u_3.Events.RequestBuyOwnedFurniture:FireServer(v154.Name)
						if v154:GetAttribute("Stock") then
							v154:SetAttribute("Stock", v154:GetAttribute("Stock") - 1)
						end
						v_u_3.Sound.Play("BuyItem", {
							["Volume"] = 0.4,
							["Duplicate"] = true
						})
						v_u_3.Sound.Play("SupplyChest")
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("spawned " .. v154.Name)
					else
						v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("not enough coins", "warning")
					end
				end
			elseif v153 == "Upgrade Flames" and v_u_19[v_u_8.Name] then
				return
			elseif (v_u_8:GetAttribute("Quantity") or 1) - (v_u_8:GetAttribute("ServerWithdrawn") or 0) > 0 then
				local v158 = string.gsub(v_u_8.Name, "[Ff][Ll][Aa][Mm][Ee]", "Offering")
				v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("taken " .. v158)
				v_u_3.Events.SpawnSupplyChest:FireServer(v_u_8, v_u_12)
				v_u_3.Sound.Play("SupplyChest")
				local v_u_159 = v_u_8.Name
				v_u_19[v_u_159] = true
				task.spawn(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_159
					wait(5)
					v_u_19[v_u_159] = false
				end)
			else
				v_u_3.PopUpUI.AddPopUp("none left", "warning")
			end
		else
			return
		end
	end)
end

RecentPings = 0
function v_u_1.Ping(p_u_77) -- name: Ping
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_3
	if RecentPings >= 4 then
		v_u_10.RBXSystem:DisplaySystemMessage("<i>Please wait before sending more pings</i>")
		DeactivatePingMode()
	else
		RecentPings = RecentPings + 1
		task.delay(15, function()
			RecentPings = RecentPings - 1
		end)
		if time() - 0 > 1 then
			task.spawn(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_77, (ref) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_3
				p_u_77.Player = v_u_2
				local v78, v79 = v_u_3.PingUtil.GetPingMessage(p_u_77, v_u_2)
				if v78 then
					v_u_3.Events.RequestBroadcastPing:FireServer(p_u_77)
					SendSystemMessage(v_u_2, v78)
					CreatePingBillboard(p_u_77)
				else
					warn("NO PING MESSAGE EXISTS:", v79)
					warn(p_u_77)
				end
			end)
		end
		DeactivatePingMode()
	end
end

end

end
function BuildMapPingData(p84, p85, p86) -- name: BuildMapPingData

			v90, v91 = v_u_3.MapDrawClient.ScaleToWorld(v92.Position.X.Scale, v92.Position.Y.Scale)
		else
			v91 = p85
			v90 = p84

		end
	else
		v91 = p85
		v90 = p84
		v89 = v88
	end
	local v93
	if v87 then
		v93 = v87:FindFirstChild("Landmarks")
	else
		v93 = v87
	end
	if v93 and (v89 ~= "Chest" and v89 ~= "Structure") then
		local v94 = RaycastParams.new()
		v94.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		v94.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v93 }
		local v95 = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(v90, 5000, v91), Vector3.new(0, -10000, 0), v94)
		local v96 = v95 and GetPingModelFromPart(v95.Instance)
		if v96 then
			local v97 = {
				["Position"] = nil,
				["Model"] = nil,
				["MapPing"] = true
			}
			local v98 = v95.Position.Y
			v97.Position = Vector3.new(p84, v98, p85)
			v97.Model = v96
			if v_u_3.PingUtil.GetPingMessage(v97, v_u_2) then
				return v97
			end
		end
	end
	local v99 = nil
	local v100
	if v87 then
		v100 = v87:FindFirstChild("Ground")
	else
		v100 = v87
	end
	if v100 then
		local v101 = RaycastParams.new()
		v101.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		v101.FilterDescendantsInstances = { v100 }
		local v102 = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p84, 5000, p85), Vector3.new(0, -10000, 0), v101)
		if v102 then
			v99 = v102.Position.Y
		end
	end
	if not v99 then
		if v87 then
			v87 = v87:FindFirstChild("Campground")
		end
		if v87 then
			v87 = v87:FindFirstChild("MainFire")
		end
		v99 = v87 and v87:GetPivot().Position.Y or 0
	end
	return v89 and {
		["Position"] = nil,
		["PingTree"] = "MapIcon",
		["IconName"] = nil,
		["MapPing"] = true,
		["Position"] = Vector3.new(p84, v99, p85),
		["IconName"] = v89

		["Position"] = nil,
		["PingTree"] = "Ground",
		["MapPing"] = true,
		["Position"] = Vector3.new(p84, v99, p85)
	}
end

	if v_u_1.PingActive then
		local v104 = nil

			local v105, v106 = v_u_3.MapDrawClient.MapPixelToWorld(p103)
			if v105 then
				v104 = BuildMapPingData(v105, v106, p103)
			end
		else
			v104 = GetPingData()
		end
		v_u_14 = v104
		v_u_13 = true
		if v104 then
			task.wait(1)
			if v104 ~= v_u_14 then
				return
			end

		end
	end
end
v_u_1.StartHoldMouse = StartHoldMouse
function EndHoldMouse() -- name: EndHoldMouse
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_14

		v_u_13 = false
		if v_u_14 then
			local v107 = v_u_14
			v_u_14 = nil
			v_u_1.Ping(v107)
		end
	end
end

function LoadConnections() -- name: LoadConnections
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_25
	v_u_5.InputBegan:Connect(function(p108, _)
		if p108.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p108.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2 then
			StartHoldMouse(p108.Position)
		end
	end)
	v_u_5.InputEnded:Connect(function(p109, _)
		if p109.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p109.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2 then
			EndHoldMouse()
		end
	end)
	v_u_5.TouchStarted:Connect(function(p110, _)
		StartHoldMouse(p110.Position)
	end)
	v_u_5.TouchEnded:Connect(function(_, _)
		EndHoldMouse()
	end)
	v_u_4:BindActionAtPriority("ClickToPing", function(_, _)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1
		if v_u_1.PingActive then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		else
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
	end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 12, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
	local v111 = v_u_25
	v_u_4:BindActionAtPriority("TogglePing", function(_, p112)
		if p112 == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			TogglePingMode()
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end
	end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value, unpack(v111))
end
